defmodule ChatServer.Room do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @moduledoc """
  Real-time chat room with audit logging and moderation.
  Supports Unicode usernames with normalization.
  """

  defstruct [:name, :members, :banned_users, :messages, :audit_log]

  def start_link(name) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, name, name: via_tuple(name))
  end

  def init(name) do
    state = %__MODULE__{
      name: name,
      members: %{},
      banned_users: MapSet.new(),
      messages: [],
      audit_log: []
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def join(room, user_id, display_name) do
    GenServer.call(via_tuple(room), {:join, user_id, display_name})
  end

  def send_message(room, user_id, content) do
    GenServer.call(via_tuple(room), {:send_message, user_id, content})
  end

  def ban_user(room, admin_id, target_display_name) do
    GenServer.call(via_tuple(room), {:ban_user, admin_id, target_display_name})
  end

  def get_audit_log(room, requester_id) do
    GenServer.call(via_tuple(room), {:get_audit_log, requester_id})
  end

  # --- Callbacks ---

  def handle_call({:join, user_id, display_name}, _from, state) do
    normalized = normalize_canonical(display_name)
    if is_banned?(normalized, state.banned_users) do
      {:reply, {:error, :banned}, state}
    else
      members = Map.put(state.members, user_id, %{display: display_name, normalized: normalized})
      audit_entry = %{action: :join, user_id: user_id, display_name: display_name, at: DateTime.utc_now()}
      new_state = %{state | members: members, audit_log: [audit_entry | state.audit_log]}
      {:reply, :ok, new_state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:send_message, user_id, content}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state.members, user_id) do
      nil ->
        {:reply, {:error, :not_member}, state}
      member_info ->
        msg = %{from: user_id, display: member_info.display, content: content, at: DateTime.utc_now()}
        audit_entry = %{action: :message, user_id: user_id, content_hash: hash_content(content), at: DateTime.utc_now()}
        new_state = %{state | messages: [msg | state.messages], audit_log: [audit_entry | state.audit_log]}
        broadcast_message(state.name, msg)
        {:reply, :ok, new_state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:ban_user, admin_id, target_display_name}, _from, state) do
    if is_admin?(admin_id, state) do
      # Normalize the target name for ban list comparison
      ban_key = normalize_canonical(target_display_name)
      new_banned = MapSet.put(state.banned_users, ban_key)
      # Remove matching members
      {removed, remaining} = Enum.split_with(state.members, fn {_uid, info} ->
        compare_normalized(info.normalized, ban_key)
      end)
      audit_entry = %{
        action: :ban,
        admin_id: admin_id,
        target: target_display_name,
        removed_count: length(removed),
        at: DateTime.utc_now()
      }
      remaining_map = Map.new(remaining)
      new_state = %{state | members: remaining_map, banned_users: new_banned, audit_log: [audit_entry | state.audit_log]}
      {:reply, {:ok, length(removed)}, new_state}
    else
      {:reply, {:error, :unauthorized}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:get_audit_log, requester_id}, _from, state) do
    if is_admin?(requester_id, state) do
      {:reply, {:ok, state.audit_log}, state}
    else
      {:reply, {:error, :unauthorized}, state}
    end
  end

  # --- Private Functions ---

  defp via_tuple(name), do: {:via, Registry, {ChatServer.Registry, name}}

  defp is_admin?(user_id, _state) do
    # In production, check against admin list/database
    String.starts_with?(to_string(user_id), "admin_")
  end

  defp is_banned?(normalized_name, banned_users) do
    Enum.any?(banned_users, fn banned ->
      compare_normalized(normalized_name, banned)
    end)
  end

  @doc """
  Normalizes display names using NFKC normalization consistently.
  NFKC provides compatibility decomposition followed by canonical composition,
  which maps visually similar characters to the same form.
  Used for both storage and ban comparison to ensure consistency.
  """
  defp normalize_canonical(name) do
    name
    |> String.trim()
    |> String.downcase()
    |> :unicode.characters_to_nfkc_binary()
    |> case do
      {:error, _, _} -> String.downcase(String.trim(name))
      result when is_binary(result) -> result
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Compares two normalized strings for equivalence.
  Both inputs are already NFKC-normalized and downcased.
  """
  defp compare_normalized(stored, ban_key) do
    stored == ban_key
  end

  defp hash_content(content) do
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, content) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  end

  defp broadcast_message(room_name, msg) do
    Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(ChatServer.PubSub, "room:#{room_name}", {:new_message, msg})
  end
end

defmodule ChatServer.AuditLogger do
  @moduledoc """
  Persistent audit logging for compliance. Writes to append-only log.
  """
  require Logger

  def log_event(event) do
    entry = %{
      timestamp: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601(),
      event: event,
      integrity_hash: compute_integrity(event)
    }
    Logger.info("[AUDIT] #{inspect(entry)}")
    append_to_log(entry)
  end

  defp compute_integrity(event) do
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, :erlang.term_to_binary(event))
    |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  end

  defp append_to_log(entry) do
    File.write!("audit.log", inspect(entry) <> "\n", [:append])
  end
end
